meta.title: CIVICLEDGER
meta.scope: NRC-awarded prime contract transactions; all sectors; action dates 2021-10-01 through 2024-09-30
caveats: Obligations are commitments, not cash outlays; outlay fields are unavailable here.
All three fiscal years are complete calendar windows as of this retrieval; the source can revise historical records.
Award timelines and first/last observation are truncated to this cohort, not award or supplier lifetime.
No misconduct labels or fraud-detection accuracy; patterns are contextual review candidates.
Names and parent reports are observed attributes. A UEI identifies a legal entity, not necessarily an independent corporate group.
Raw full-field archives remain local. 4 contact-bearing descriptions are omitted from this public snapshot.
unavailable: Tender notice dates and tender duration

privacy_transformations.rule: Whole description omitted when email address or North American telephone pattern is detected; raw original unchanged.

meta.concentration_convention: Positive recipient-year net obligation shares, HHI 0–10000; signed net flows always retained separately.

net_obligations.label: Net obligations
net_obligations.sql: SELECT fiscal_year,SUM(obligation) FROM fact_transactions GROUP BY fiscal_year
net_obligations.denominator: All in-scope prime contract transaction actions
net_obligations.interpretation: A promise to pay, not cash disbursed; reversals reduce this total.
net_obligations.benign_explanation: Routine option exercise, incremental funding and deobligation all change totals.

hhi.label: Supplier HHI
hhi.formula: 10,000 × SUM((max(recipient-year net obligation,0) / SUM(max(recipient-year net obligation,0)))²)
hhi.denominator: Sum of positive recipient-year net balances; negative recipient balances remain in net-obligation totals but have zero concentration weight.
hhi.interpretation: 0–10,000 scale; describes allocation within NRC, not the relevant economic market.
hhi.benign_explanation: Specialized scientific and technical requirements may concentrate funding.

top4_share.label: Top-four share
top4_share.formula: Sum of the four largest positive recipient-year net shares
top4_share.benign_explanation: Large multiyear service awards and specialized expertise can explain concentrated allocations.

competition_share.label: Competed gross obligations
competition_share.denominator: Positive action obligations, including unknown competition in denominator
competition_share.interpretation: Recorded extent competed; modifications inherit competition context and do not represent new tenders.
competition_share.benign_explanation: Authorized sole-source or follow-on work may be recorded as not competed.

single_offer_rate.label: Single-offer competed action rate
single_offer_rate.formula: Competed actions with one reported offer / competed actions with known number of offers
single_offer_rate.denominator: Competed action records with known offers, not distinct procurements
single_offer_rate.interpretation: Modifications can repeat an award’s offer count. Bid-level participation and bidder identities are unavailable.
single_offer_rate.benign_explanation: Specialist markets, incumbent expertise or a narrow scope can yield a single offer.

september_share.label: September share
september_share.formula: September positive action obligations / annual positive action obligations
september_share.denominator: All positive action obligations in fiscal year
september_share.benign_explanation: Budget availability, annual funding cycles and option timing can explain September concentrations.

parent_hhi.label: Reported parent HHI
parent_hhi.formula: HHI after assigning EACH action to its contemporaneously reported parent UEI; fall back to recipient UEI
parent_hhi.interpretation: Reported parent mappings change and are not verified beneficial ownership. Values can move in either direction because parent reports change within recipient histories.
parent_hhi.benign_explanation: Ownership, reporting corrections or identifier changes may explain parent changes.

transaction_count.label: Transaction records
transaction_count.benign_explanation: Many modifications can represent routine incremental funding, not unusual behavior.

award_count.label: Awards observed
award_count.denominator: Awards with at least one action in the selected window
award_count.benign_explanation: Cohort includes older awards modified during these years.
